0|f7084059a9cb9e56a186e1677b1dcffd76c2cd24|torvalds~linux|/home/usuario01/Titan-Files-Research/src/_00/output/C/torvalds~linux|False|"bnx2x: Improve reliability in case of nested PCI errors
While in recovery process of PCI error (called EEH on PowerPC arch)
another PCI transaction could be corrupted causing a situation of
nested PCI errors. Also
column2: this scenario could be reproduced with

column1: error injection mechanisms (for debug purposes).
We observe that in case of nested PCI errors
initialize its shmem and cause a kernel crash due to bad addresses
read from MCP. Multiple different stack traces were observed depending
on the point the second PCI error happens.
This patch avoids the crashes by:
* failing PCI recovery in case of nested errors (since multiple
PCI errors in a row are not expected to lead to a functional
adapter anyway)
* preventing access to adapter FW when MCP is failed (we mark it as
failed when shmem cannot get initialized properly).
